name: echo loading
description: Proposal. Working or planning: after one blink the visor goes dark around the open eyes, the eyes sink into it and the band is a braille loading bar, a dark track that fills left to right in ping one column a frame with the top dot first, the bottom dot settling one column behind and a flash cursor one cell ahead, then it holds full, flashes once, empties in one frame and the eyes come back with an antenna ping; the eyes are gone only while the band is the bar, so judge whether the staggered two row fill reads as a braille loading bar and not a wipe.
